
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/WearOpenWei/p/23309534" title="发布于 2026-10-15 08:54">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">SQL 数据库NULL值判断</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 id="activity-name" class="rich_media_title "><span class="js_title_inner">SQL 数据库NULL值判断，is null / is not null，禁止使用=NULL</span></h1>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="sql"><code><span class="code-snippet__keyword"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>判断字段是否为空很多新手写<code><span>where col = NULL</span></code><span><span>，查询返回空结果，不会报错但是查不出任何数据，是高频隐形bug。</span></span></span></span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []">场景：统计用户表手机号为空、不为空的数据，对比错误等于NULL写法的坑。核心知识点：三值逻辑、IS NULL、IS NOT NULL、<span>IFNULL函数。</span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>① 生成测试数据</span></h4>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="sql"><code><span class="code-snippet__keyword">CREATE TABLE&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">member(</span></span></code><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; uid&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__type">INT&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">PRIMARY KEY&nbsp;AUTO_INCREMENT,</span></span></code><code>&nbsp; &nbsp; username&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__type">VARCHAR(<span class="code-snippet__number">32),</span></span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; phone&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__type">VARCHAR(<span class="code-snippet__number">20)&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">NULL</span></span></span></span></code><code>);</code><code><br></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">INSERT INTO&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">member(username,phone)&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">VALUES</span></span></span></span></code><code>(<span class="code-snippet__string">'小明',<span class="code-snippet__string">'13800138000'),</span></span></code><code>(<span class="code-snippet__string">'小红',<span class="code-snippet__keyword">NULL),</span></span></code><code>(<span class="code-snippet__string">'小刚',<span class="code-snippet__string">'13900139000'),</span></span></code><code>(<span class="code-snippet__string">'小丽',<span class="code-snippet__keyword">NULL);<br><br></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>② 核心SQL</span></h4>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="sql"><code>-- 错误写法，不会报错但是查不到任何数据</code><code><span class="code-snippet__keyword">SELECT&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__operator">*&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">FROM&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">member&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">WHERE&nbsp;phone&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__operator">=&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">NULL;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><br></code><code>-- 正确 判断为空</code><code><span class="code-snippet__keyword">SELECT&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__operator">*&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">FROM&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">member&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">WHERE&nbsp;phone&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">IS&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">NULL;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><br></code><code>-- 正确 判断不为空</code><code><span class="code-snippet__keyword">SELECT&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__operator">*&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">FROM&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">member&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">WHERE&nbsp;phone&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">IS&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">NOT NULL;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><br></code><code>-- IFNULL空值替换，NULL展示为'未填写'</code><code><span class="code-snippet__keyword">SELECT&nbsp;uid,username,IFNULL(phone,<span class="code-snippet__string">'未填写')&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">AS&nbsp;phone&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">FROM&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">member;</span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="sql"><code><span class="code-snippet__string"><span class="code-snippet__keyword">&nbsp;</span></span></code></pre>
<h4 data-pm-slice="0 0 []">③SQL结果</h4>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="sql"><code>-- IS NULL结果</code><code>uid &nbsp;username phone</code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">2&nbsp; &nbsp; 小红 &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">NULL</span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">4&nbsp; &nbsp; 小丽 &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">NULL</span></span></span></code><code><br></code><code>-- IFNULL输出</code><code>uid &nbsp;username phone</code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__number">1&nbsp; &nbsp; 小明&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">13800138000</span></span></span></code><code><span class="code-snippet__number">2&nbsp; &nbsp; 小红 未填写</span></code></pre>
<ul>
<li><span>NULL不能使用 = 、!= 做比较，只能IS NULL / IS NOT NULL；</span></li>
<li><code><span>col = NULL</span></code><span>不会报错，但返回空集合，属于隐蔽业务bug；</span></li>
<li><span>IFNULL函数可以对查询结果的NULL做展示层替换；</span></li>
<li><span>建表阶段业务关键字段尽量设置NOT NULL约束，从源头减少NULL。</span></li>
</ul>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="sql"><code><span class="code-snippet__string"><span class="code-snippet__keyword">&nbsp;</span></span></code></pre>

</div>
